messages.subject: Overlaying CIM plots
parts:
Karl,

Instead of plotting three composite intervals into 3 separate panels, I would like to overlay them.

The three CIMs are with windows of 20, 40, and Inf. I am able to plot any combination of 2 of these (in addition to the original scanone) with (for example):

plot(qtl.scan1, cim.20, cim.inf, chr = chr)

giving me:


However, when I try plotting all three:

plot(qtl.scan1, cim.20, cim.40, cim.inf, chr = chr)

I get the following error:

Error in `+.scanone`(lodcolumn, 2) : Input should have class "scanone".

Is there any way to fix this?

Thanks,

Nathaniel
